modules.title: 点加号后，为什么只更新这块？
状态变化怎样带来局部更新

items.title: 组件是一小块可传参的界面
items.text: 按钮、卡片都可以封装为独立组件。组件通过外部传入的参数（Props，如标题、价格）决定展示内容，从而能在不同页面复用同一套界面结构。

items.title: 状态记住当前值
items.text: 点击把计数从 0 改成 1；状态就是这块界面此刻要显示的值。

items.title: React 按新值计算界面
items.text: React 重新计算相关组件的输出，渲染器再按需更新实际 DOM，所以按钮文字变了。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 组件更新不等于整页重新加载；是否请求服务器、保存数据或切换网址，仍由项目里的其他代码决定。

lessonPractice.title: 购物车数量会在商品卡、顶部徽标和结算区同时出现，修改后要一起更新。怎样组织更省事？

options.label: 让多个 React 组件读取同一份状态，数量变化后统一重新显示
options.feedback: 共享状态作为唯一画面依据，能避免三个位置各自维护并逐个同步。

options.label: 分别查找三个 DOM 节点，每次点击后手工修改它们的文字
options.feedback: 手工同步容易遗漏新位置，也把数据来源分散在多个操作步骤里。

options.label: 只更新 React 状态，并假设刷新页面后购物车会自动保留
options.feedback: React 负责当前画面更新，刷新后的数据仍需要本地或服务器持久化。

en.title: Cart quantity appears in a product card, top badge, and checkout summary and must update together. How should it be organized?

options.label: Have multiple React components read one state and render together when quantity changes
options.feedback: One state becomes the view source, avoiding separate values and manual synchronization across locations.

options.label: Find three DOM nodes and manually rewrite each one's text after every click
options.feedback: Manual synchronization misses new locations easily and scatters the data source across operations.

options.label: Update React state and assume the cart remains after a page refresh
options.feedback: React updates the current view; persistence after refresh still requires local or server storage.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让商品卡、顶部徽标和结算区从同一份购物车状态读取数量，不要逐个修改 DOM。更新后同步三个位置；另行说明持久化方案，并用刷新页面验证数据是否真正保存。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make the product card, top badge, and checkout summary read quantity from one cart state rather than editing DOM nodes. Update all three together, define persistence separately, and refresh to verify saved data.

learning.assumes: You know a number on a button can change after a click.
learning.outcome: You can explain how a click changes a React value and refreshes the related interface.

modules.title: Why does only this part update after a click?
How a state change updates a component

items.title: A component is an interface piece that accepts inputs
items.text: Buttons and cards can be separate components. Components receive external parameters (Props, like title or price) to control content, allowing the same UI structure to be reused across pages.

items.title: State holds the current value
items.text: A click changes a counter from 0 to 1; state is what this part should show now.

items.title: React recalculates the view
items.text: React recalculates the related component and the renderer updates the needed DOM.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A component update is not a full-page reload. Requests, saved data, and URL changes are handled by other project code.
